items.title: Vectra AI Launches Ascent to Help Address New Era of AI-Driven Attacks
items.description: The new program expands Vectra AI's partner strategy as increasingly complex security environments and the growing use of AI create demand for broader AI expertise, services, and security outcomes.

items.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues

items.title: EY Survey Finds Autonomous AI Implementation Outpaces Oversight
items.description: A new survey of senior AI execs shows that while organizations are rapidly deploying AI and autonomous systems, their process and controls are not keeping pace.

items.title: MFA Won't Save You From OAuth Consent Abuse
items.description: MFA is essential, but it cannot replace OAuth governance, least-privilege scopes, consent monitoring, and rapid revocation.

items.title: Public Exploits Released for Four Linux Kernel Flaws That Enable Local Root
items.description: A security researcher has released working exploit code for four Linux kernel flaws that each let a local user gain root, the highest level of access on a machine. Kernel maintainers have fixed all four over the past few weeks, so a system running an up-to-date kernel is not affected. items.description: WordPress today released patches to fix a new set of vulnerabilities in its core software, one of which could allow a crafted web link, opened by a logged-in administrator, to install a theme from the official WordPress.org directory without anyone clicking Install. items.title: Secure enterprise sharing with access reviews for Microsoft 365
items.description: Microsoft 365 makes sharing files easy, but access can remain long after its original purpose has ended, leaving organizations with little visibility into who can still reach sensitive data. tenfold Software explains how centralized access governance and owner-driven reviews can help identify and remove unnecessary access. items.description: Fast-growing companies face countless recommendations for securing Google Workspace, but not every control provides the same value. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-85889, carries a CVSS score of 10.0. items.title: 23 Million User Records Compromised in Gyazo Data Breach

items.title: An Abandoned CDN Domain Was Re-Registered. Thousands of Sites Still Call It.
items.description: In July 2025, someone registered a domain that used to belong to a content delivery network.
